info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Creditcard Applications Creditchecks-v5-spec
info.description: The Credit Card Application Credit Check API allows users to retrieve credit check information associated with submitted credit card applications. This endpoint serves as a vital resource for financial institutions and credit assessment agencies to evaluate the creditworthiness of applicants. By leveraging this API, consumers can streamline the decision-making process for loan approvals and risk assessments. Use cases include integrating credit check data into credit card application workflows and enhancing applicant evaluation strategies.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve a list of applications that have undergone a credit check. You can use this to assess the creditworthiness of applicants based on their submitted data.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve credit check information for applications. It expects a JSON payload that adheres to the specified schema.

202.description: Request has been accepted for processing, but the processing is not yet complete.

ListCreditcardApplicationsCreditchecksRe.description: This schema represents the request body for the Credit Check operation in the Applications API. It is designed to accept a string value.

status.description: Indicates whether the credit check operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number associated with the credit check request.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the credit check process.

state.description: Current state of the credit check operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the credit check request in milliseconds.

message.description: Optional message providing additional details about the credit check operation.

audit.description: Audit information related to the credit check operation.

ListCreditcardApplicationsCreditchecksRe.description: Response schema for the credit check operation. It contains the status, reference number, result ID, state, processing time, message, and audit information.

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the credit check record.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the credit check record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the credit check was performed automatically.

Audit.description: Audit information for the credit check operation, including who created the record and when it was created.

x-processing-time.description: The time taken by the server to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
